{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667259576,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"hkJEG5VRNkTTx9tS","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"=== UNIT ECONOMICS ===\")\n    # Gen H purchase at month m, used until month 23, marked at month 24 at 75% of 25 * 0.98^24 * 0.6 (since gen N launched)\n    used_h_m24 = 25 * (0.98 ** 24) * 0.6\n    mark_h_m24 = 0.75 * used_h_m24\n    print(f\"Gen H used value at m24 (post-N): ${used_h_m24:.3f}M, 75% resale/mark: ${mark_h_m24:.3f}M\")\n    \n    # Effective capex depreciation of 1k Gen H bought from vendor ($25M) and held to end:\n    dep_h_vendor = 25.0 - mark_h_m24\n    print(f\"Gen H vendor net depreciation over 24m: ${dep_h_vendor:.3f}M per kH\")\n    # If powered with NEW power (24m contract at $0.15/MW-m * 1.4 MW = $5.04M):\n    tot_h_new_power = dep_h_vendor + 5.04\n    print(f\"Gen H vendor + new power total cost if bought at m0 (21 active months m3..23): ${tot_h_new_power:.3f}M -> ${tot_h_new_power/21:.3f}M/kH-m\")\n    # If using EXISTING power (free until m19):\n    print(f\"Gen H vendor using existing power (until m19, 17m m3..19): ${dep_h_vendor:.3f}M -> ${dep_h_vendor/17:.3f}M/kH-m (plus $5.04M if extended to m23 for 21m -> ${(dep_h_vendor+5.04)/21:.3f}M/kH-m)\")\n\n    # Broker A ($27.5M, 80% refund on cancel)\n    # Expected cost if reliable (90% deliver, 10% cancel -> pay 27.5, get back 22 on cancel -> lose 5.5):\n    # Wait: per 1k delivered, expected extra waste from cancels = (0.1/0.9)*5.5 = $0.611M -> $28.11M\n    # If unreliable (35% deliver): (0.65/0.35)*5.5 = $10.21M -> $37.71M!\n    print(f\"Broker A effective cost per delivered kH: reliable=${27.5 + (0.1/0.9)*5.5:.2f}M, unreliable=${27.5 + (0.65/0.35)*5.5:.2f}M\")\n    print(f\"Broker B effective cost per delivered kH: reliable=${31.25 + (0.1/0.9)*6.25:.2f}M, unreliable=${31.25 + (0.65/0.35)*6.25:.2f}M\")\n\n    # Gen N purchase at month L..23:\n    # Price $40M for 2 kH ($20M per kH!). Needs 1.6 MW per 1k = 0.8 MW per kH.\n    # Power cost per kH (24m contract): 0.8 * 3.6 = $2.88M per kH.\n    for L in [12, 13, 14, 15, 16]:\n        # Suppose ordered at L, arrives L+3, active months L+3..23 -> (24 - (L+3)) months\n        active = 24 - (L + 3)\n        # Value at month 24: 40 * 0.98^(24 - L) * 0.75 for 2 kH -> per kH is half\n        mark_n_m24 = 0.5 * 0.75 * 40 * (0.98 ** (24 - L))\n        dep_n = 20.0 - mark_n_m24\n        tot_n = dep_n + 2.88\n        print(f\"Gen N ordered at L={L}, active {active}m (m{L+3}..23): capex_dep=${dep_n:.2f}M/kH, +power=${tot_n:.2f}M/kH -> ${tot_n/active:.3f}M/kH-m\")\n\n    # What about buying Gen H and reselling it later when Gen N arrives?\n    # Note: resell limit is 3k per gen per month, and used value drops 40% at Gen N launch!\n    # Before launch (say month 12), used H = 25 * 0.98^12 = 19.61, 75% = 14.71 -> lose 25 - 14.71 = $10.29M for ~9 months = $1.14M/kH-m!\n    # After launch (say month 15), used H = 25 * 0.98^15 * 0.6 = 11.08, 75% = 8.31 -> lose 25 - 8.31 = $16.69M!\n    print(\"\\n=== WINDOW 0..7 CAPACITY BUDGET ===\")\n    # Current capacity at m0..7:\n    # Owned H: 10 kH (m0..7 = 80 kH-m)\n    # Queue H: 4k (placed m-2 -> arrives m1 at earliest, if shipped in m0! That's 7m * 4 = 28 kH-m)\n    # Reserved: 2 kH in m0..4 (5m * 2 = 10 kH-m)\n    base_cap = 80 + 28 + 10\n    print(f\"Baseline capacity m0..7 (assuming 4k queue arrives m1): {base_cap} kH-m\")\n    for g in [0.03, 0.07]:\n        inf = sum(6.0 * ((1 + g) ** m) for m in range(8))\n        req = inf + 60.0\n        gap = req - base_cap\n        print(f\"  Growth {g*100:.0f}%: inf={inf:.1f}, +train(60)={req:.1f}, gap={gap:.1f} kH-m\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/analyze.py","time":{"start":1794667259558,"end":1794667259565}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da81268c001OhdSJHeeSSH13s","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da80da45001Ea0FgvFaBHd4rf"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667334436,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"ncZIs3jzSvRqZ32x","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/model.py","content":"import math\n\n# Check exact resale/mark-to-market and power math\ndef gen_h_cost(order_m, power_m=None, retire_m=24):\n    # Ordered at order_m, usable from order_m+3 .. 23 (assuming shipped in time)\n    start = order_m + 3\n    usable_months = max(0, 24 - start)\n    # Marked at month 24 (post Gen N launch): 0.75 * 25 * 0.98^24 * 0.6\n    mark_24 = 0.75 * 25.0 * (0.98 ** 24) * 0.6\n    capex_net = 25.0 - mark_24\n    # Power: 1.4 MW * $0.15M * 24 = $5.04M (if new power needed)\n    power_cost = 1.4 * 0.15 * 24\n    return capex_net, power_cost, usable_months, (capex_net + power_cost) / usable_months\n\ndef gen_n_cost(order_m, launch_m):\n    start = order_m + 3\n    usable_months = max(0, 24 - start)\n    # 1k Gen N = 2 kH, costs $40M, needs 1.6 MW\n    mark_24 = 0.75 * 40.0 * (0.98 ** (24 - launch_m))\n    capex_net = (40.0 - mark_24) / 2.0 # per kH\n    power_cost = (1.6 / 2.0) * 0.15 * 24 # per kH\n    return capex_net, power_cost, usable_months, (capex_net + power_cost) / usable_months if usable_months > 0 else 999\n\nprint(\"Gen H ordered at month m (held to m24):\")\nfor m in range(0, 14):\n    c, p, u, rate = gen_h_cost(m)\n    print(f\"  m={m:2d}: usable m{m+3:2d}..23 ({u:2d}m), capex_net={c:.2f}, power={p:.2f}, total/kH-m={rate:.3f}\")\n\nprint(\"\\nGen N ordered at launch_m (held to m24):\")\nfor L in range(11, 19):\n    c, p, u, rate = gen_n_cost(L, L)\n    print(f\"  L={L:2d}: usable m{L+3:2d}..23 ({u:2d}m), capex_net={c:.2f}, power={p:.2f}, total/kH-m={rate:.3f}\")\n\nprint(\"\\nGen N ordered at launch_m+1:\")\nfor L in range(11, 19):\n    c, p, u, rate = gen_n_cost(L+1, L)\n    print(f\"  L={L:2d}, ord={L+1:2d}: usable m{L+4:2d}..23 ({u:2d}m), capex_net={c:.2f}, power={p:.2f}, total/kH-m={rate:.3f}\")\n\n# Check cash flow if we buy H early\n# Starting cash = 400. Monthly funding = +40.\n# Monthly power cost for existing 16 MW = 16 * 0.15 = 2.4M/mo (m0..19).\n# Monthly contract cost for existing 2 kH = 2 * 2.0 = 4.0M/mo (m0..4).\nprint(\"\\nCash trajectory baseline (no new orders):\")\ncash = 400\nfor m in range(6):\n    charges = 2.4 + (4.0 if m <= 4 else 0)\n    cash = cash - charges + 40\n    print(f\"  end m{m}: cash={cash:.1f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/model.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/model.py","time":{"start":1794667334396,"end":1794667334418}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da824ae8001kvCw9Ok4fRaBnU","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da81f513001y1U1SSty2hSKT9"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667443930,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"rK4gm1JNYsoUc86p","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import numpy as np\n\n# Let's simulate demand & capacity over 24 months under different procurement plans\ndef sim_demand(g1=0.03, g2=None, switch_m=12):\n    d = []\n    cur = 6.0\n    for m in range(24):\n        d.append(cur)\n        g = g1 if (g2 is None or m < switch_m) else g2\n        cur = cur * (1 + g)\n    return d\n\nfor name, g1, g2 in [(\"3% steady\", 0.03, None), (\"3%->7% at m10\", 0.03, 0.07), (\"7%->3% at m10\", 0.07, 0.03), (\"7% steady\", 0.07, None)]:\n    d = sim_demand(g1, g2, 10)\n    print(f\"{name:15s}: W0(0..7)={sum(d[0:8]):5.1f} (+60={sum(d[0:8])+60:5.1f}), \"\n          f\"W1(8..15)={sum(d[8:16]):5.1f} (+140={sum(d[8:16])+140:5.1f}), \"\n          f\"W2(16..23)={sum(d[16:24]):5.1f} (+320={sum(d[16:24])+320:5.1f}), \"\n          f\"Total={sum(d)+520:5.1f}\")\n    print(f\"   end-of-window monthly inf: m7={d[7]:.1f}, m15={d[15]:.1f}, m23={d[23]:.1f}\")\n\nprint(\"\\nAvg kH/month needed per window:\")\nfor name, g1, g2 in [(\"3% steady\", 0.03, None), (\"3%->7% at m10\", 0.03, 0.07), (\"7% steady\", 0.07, None)]:\n    d = sim_demand(g1, g2, 10)\n    print(f\"{name:15s}: W0={(sum(d[0:8])+60)/8:5.2f}, W1={(sum(d[8:16])+140)/8:5.2f}, W2={(sum(d[16:24])+320)/8:5.2f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_demand.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_demand.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/sim_demand.py","time":{"start":1794667443889,"end":1794667443909}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da83f68f0015pQxL4CLCZo82T","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da828970001wggTVb2NDgiLc7"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667789320,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"EZk19fGI1fERNLIS","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import random\nimport numpy as np\n\n# Let's simulate the full 24-month economics of different initial H buildouts\n# We want to see:\n# 1) Total net cost under 3% vs 7% demand growth, loose vs tight, Gen N at m12..16\n# 2) Cash trajectory (does it ever go deeply negative?)\n# 3) Training run feasibility\n\ndef eval_strategy(h_buy_m0, h_buy_m1, power_m0, res6_m0, growth=0.05, launch_m=14, tight_prob=0.25):\n    # Deterministic expected-value check for quick comparison\n    # Demand\n    inf = [6.0 * ((1 + growth) ** m) for m in range(24)]\n    # Existing: 10k H, 4k H in queue (arrives m1 if loose, m2 if tight)\n    # Power: 16 MW m0..19\n    # Contract: 2 kH m0..4 ($2M/mo)\n    pass\n\n# Let's check exact cost of 1k H bought at m0 vs m1 vs m4 vs cloud vs Gen N\n# Wait: what if we own 26k H (10 + 4 + 12) by m4, AND Gen N launches at m14?\n# By m16..23:\n# 26k H gives 26 kH/month -> 26 * 8 = 208 kH-m in W2 (m16..23).\n# Need in W2: 406 kH-m (3%) to 502 kH-m (7%).\n# Gap in W2: 198 kH-m (3%) to 294 kH-m (7%) -> 25 to 37 kH/month!\n# Where does 25-37 kH/month come from in m16..23?\n# If Gen N launches at m14:\n#   ordered at m14: up to 4k/mo loose (8 kH/mo!) -> m17..23 (7m)\n#   ordered at m15: 8 kH/mo -> m18..23 (6m)\n#   ordered at m16: 8 kH/mo -> m19..23 (5m)\n# Notice that if Gen N launches at m16 (or supply is tight!), Gen N CANNOT cover m16..18 at all!\n# Let's print the max Gen N kH-m available in W2 (m16..23) as a function of Launch Month L and Supply!\n\nfor L in [11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]:\n    for supply, rate_k in [(\"Loose (4k/mo)\", 4.0), (\"Tight (1.5k/mo)\", 1.5)]:\n        # Assume we order each month from L..20, ships at rate_k per month, usable max(order_m+3, ship_m+1)?\n        # Wait: if ordered at L, shipped at L (rate_k), usable L+3..23 -> 24-(L+3) months.\n        # Ordered at L+1 (or queued at L and shipped at L+1!):\n        # Wait: if we place ONE big order at L, it's in the queue from month L!\n        # So ships rate_k in L -> usable L+3..23!\n        # Ships rate_k in L+1 -> usable L+3..23? Wait: \"Orders join a FIFO queue, usable from 3 months after ordering at the earliest.\"\n        # Wait: if ordered at L, and shipped at L+1, L+2, L+3:\n        # Does \"usable from 3 months after ordering at the earliest\" mean max(order_m + 3, ship_m + 1)?\n        # If shipped in m=L+1, m+1 = L+2 < L+3 -> usable L+3!\n        # If shipped in m=L+2, m+1 = L+3 -> usable L+3!\n        # If shipped in m=L+3, m+1 = L+4 -> usable L+4!\n        # Let's conservatively assume shipped in m -> usable max(L+3, m+1):\n        tot_khm = 0\n        for ship_offset in range(8):\n            m_ship = L + ship_offset\n            m_use = max(L + 3, m_ship + 1)\n            if m_use <= 23:\n                tot_khm += rate_k * 2 * (24 - m_use) # 2 kH per 1k N\n        if supply == \"Loose (4k/mo)\":\n            loose_val = tot_khm\n        else:\n            print(f\"Launch L={L:2d}: max Gen N kH-m in W2 = {loose_val:5.1f} (loose) / {tot_khm:5.1f} (tight)\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/check_gen_n.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/check_gen_n.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/check_gen_n.py","time":{"start":1794667789123,"end":1794667789214}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da893afb001OPCrxJx5h98yQt","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da84225d001T2fmk2IuYybNRb"}}

So 28k H fits completely under 40 MW!\n# What about W1 (m8..15) and W2 (m16..23)?\n\nfor total_h in [24, 26, 28]:\n    buy_m0 = total_h - 14\n    print(f\"=== Total H = {total_h}k (buy {buy_m0}k at m0, cost=${buy_m0*25}M, cash left=${400 - buy_m0*25}M) ===\")\n    for g_name, inf_w1, inf_w2 in [(\"3% steady\", 67.6, 85.6), (\"3->7% m10\", 73.1, 124.2), (\"7->3% m10\", 97.7, 125.3), (\"7% steady\", 105.8, 181.7)]:\n        req_w1 = inf_w1 + 140\n        req_w2 = inf_w2 + 320\n        cap_w1 = total_h * 8\n        cap_w2 = total_h * 8\n        gap_w1 = req_w1 - cap_w1\n        gap_w2 = req_w2 - cap_w2\n        print(f\"  {g_name:10s}: W1 req={req_w1:5.1f}, cap={cap_w1:3d}, gap={gap_w1:+5.1f} | W2 req={req_w2:5.1f}, cap={cap_w2:3d}, gap={gap_w2:+5.1f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/compare_h.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/compare_h.py","time":{"start":1794667859296,"end":1794667859310}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da8a4d5a001F55KTOsqu4HBrs","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da899ef1001YqV6qlM2dLFemb"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667990693,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"TjmvA7yzcS7vRFXG","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m1_bayes.py","content":"import math\n\n# 1. Bayesian update for supply regime at m0 and m1\n# At m0: vendor shipped 1.75k.\n# Loose: 6k * U(0.7, 1.3) = U(4.2, 7.8) -> prob of 1.75k is 0!\n# Tight: 2k * U(0.7, 1.3) = U(1.4, 2.6) -> prob > 0!\n# Wait: could export controls be active at m0? No, export controls are m5..15!\n# So P(tight at m0) = 1.0!\n\n# Transition m0 -> m1: switches with prob 0.10.\np_tight_prior_m1 = 0.90\np_loose_prior_m1 = 0.10\n\n# Observations at start of m1:\n# 1) Contract index drifted 1.600 -> 1.675 (+4.6875%).\n#    Loose drift: -2.5% with ~5% noise -> N(-0.025, 0.05) -> z = (0.0469 - (-0.025))/0.05 = +1.44\n#    Tight drift: +4.0% with ~5% noise -> N(+0.040, 0.05) -> z = (0.0469 - 0.040)/0.05 = +0.14\n#    Note: Wait, does m1's index drift reflect m0's regime or m1's regime?\n#    m0's regime drove the transition from m0 index to m1 index! Since m0 was definitely tight, the drift +4.69% was from m0 tight!\n# 2) Spot price at m1: $2.092M vs index $1.675M -> ratio = 1.249.\n#    Loose: ~1.1x with ~30% noise -> std ~0.33 (or lognormal/normal around 1.1)\n#    Tight: ~1.8x with ~30% noise -> std ~0.54 (around 1.8)\ndef gauss_pdf(x, mu, sigma):\n    return math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mu) / sigma) ** 2) / (sigma * math.sqrt(2 * math.pi))\n\n# Assuming multiplicative ~30% noise: sigma_L = 1.1*0.3 = 0.33, sigma_T = 1.8*0.3 = 0.54\nl_spot_L = gauss_pdf(1.249, 1.1, 0.33)\nl_spot_T = gauss_pdf(1.249, 1.8, 0.54)\np_tight_m1 = (p_tight_prior_m1 * l_spot_T) / (p_tight_prior_m1 * l_spot_T + p_loose_prior_m1 * l_spot_L)\nprint(f\"Spot ratio 1.249: L_loose={l_spot_L:.3f}, L_tight={l_spot_T:.3f}, P(tight at m1)={p_tight_m1:.3f}\")\n\n# 2. Check Broker test value\n# Suppose we test Broker A with 0.5k ($13.75M) or 1k ($27.5M) vs Broker B.\n# If we buy 1k from Broker A now:\n# - Paid $27.5M now. End of m2: 90% delivers (usable m3? No, \"usable from 2 months after ordering\" -> ordered m1, usable m3; power at m5 -> sits idle m3..4, used m5..23 = 19m!).\n# - If cancels at end of m2: get $22M back, lose $5.5M, and learn A is likely unreliable (13.3% reliable).\n# - Wait: if we wait until m3 to test Broker A (so if it delivers at end of m4, usable m5 right when 40MW power turns on!),\n#   we save 0 idle months AND still know A's reliability by end of m4 (BEFORE m5 export controls!).\nprint(\"\\nIf Broker A tested at m3 (usable m5):\")\nprint(\"  End of m4 we know outcome, right before m5!\")\nprint(\"  Wait: what if we test 0.5k Broker A at m3? Max loss = $2.75M, usable m5 if delivered!\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m1_bayes.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m1_bayes.py","time":{"start":1794667990676,"end":1794667990684}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da8c4e8d001WZt9AvgcIouvvm","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da8aa2e20011ssJOBqrtvOfCn"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668328132,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"xDdRnI8BJN5x1Yj4","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Compare keeping 1k Gen H in m20..23 (requires 1.4 MW new power) vs reselling 1k Gen H at m20\n# Note: we ALREADY have 24 MW covering m20..23 (powers 17.14k H).\n# The 16 MW expiring at end of m19 affects the remaining 26 - 17.14 = 8.86k H (12.4 MW).\n# Wait: if we buy Gen N at m12..14, Gen N needs 0.8 MW per kH vs Gen H's 1.4 MW per kH!\n\n# Cost of keeping 1k Gen H for m20..23 (4 months) if it requires signing 1.4 MW of 24m power:\nused_h_m20 = 25 * (0.98 ** 20) * 0.6\nused_h_m24 = 25 * (0.98 ** 24) * 0.6\nresale_m20 = 0.75 * used_h_m20\nmark_m24 = 0.75 * used_h_m24\ndep_20_24 = resale_m20 - mark_m24\npower_1k_h = 1.4 * 3.6 # $5.04M for 24m\ncost_keep_h_m20_23 = dep_20_24 + power_1k_h\nprint(f\"Resale H at m20: ${resale_m20:.2f}M, Mark H at m24: ${mark_m24:.2f}M, dep=${dep_20_24:.2f}M\")\nprint(f\"Keep 1k H for m20..23 WITH new 1.4MW power: ${cost_keep_h_m20_23:.2f}M for 4 kH-m = ${cost_keep_h_m20_23/4:.2f}M/kH-m!\")\nprint(f\"Keep 1k H for m20..23 if power ALREADY active (marginal 0 power): ${dep_20_24:.2f}M for 4 kH-m = ${dep_20_24/4:.2f}M/kH-m!\")\n\n# Compare: what if we buy 1k Gen N (2 kH) at L=13 (arrives m16, active m16..23 = 8m) WITH new 1.6 MW power?\n# In m16..19 we need 1.6 MW new power anyway. In m20..23 that SAME 1.6 MW keeps running!\n# And if we resell 1k H at m20 (saving 1.4 MW in m20..23), wait: 1k Gen N only uses 0.8 MW/kH ($2.88M/kH) vs Gen H 1.4 MW/kH ($5.04M/kH)!\n# Look at that:\n# If we DON'T renew the 16 MW for Gen H at m20, and instead resell ~9k Gen H at m20..22 (note resell limit is 3k/month!),\n# WAIT: why would we resell H at m20 if we need 51-63 kH in m16..23?\n# Because keeping 1k H in m20..23 with new power costs $1.44M/kH-m, whereas post-launch cloud (after 25% drop!) might be $1.00-$1.40M/kH-m!\n# Wait: what is the cloud index likely to be at m13 after 25% drop?\n# Current index at m6 = $1.912M. If tight continues 7 more months (+4%/mo): 1.912 * 1.04^7 = $2.516M -> * 0.75 = $1.887M!\n# If loose happens half the time: ~2.0 * 0.75 = $1.50M!\n# Either way, $1.44M/kH-m for keeping H in m20..23 is STILL <= post-launch cloud (~$1.50-$1.89M/kH-m)!\nprint(f\"If cloud index at m13 is $2.0M -> post-launch 12m is $1.50M, 6m is $1.725M; keeping H at $1.44M/kH-m is STILL competitive or cheaper!\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/check_m20.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/check_m20.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/check_m20.py","time":{"start":1794668328128,"end":1794668328130}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da9174bd001s0svRPjyhw5Mmx","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da914769001dT7Vhgjt1KclCY"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668367327,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"VBRdmA1YP14svwQL","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math, random\n\n# 1. Supply regime at m8\n# m7 shipped 1.53k? Wait: remaining in queue was 1.53k! So 1.53k could be tight OR loose (capped by remaining queue!).\n# Wait! Look at m7->m8 index: 1.961 -> 2.061 = +5.10%!\n# +5.10% is strong evidence m7 was TIGHT (mean +4% vs -2.5%, std 5%)!\ndef gpdf(x, mu, s):\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((x-mu)/s)**2)/(s*math.sqrt(2*math.pi))\n\n# Update m7 regime using index drift +5.10%\np_T7_prior = 0.85\np_T7 = (p_T7_prior * gpdf(0.051, 0.04, 0.05)) / (p_T7_prior * gpdf(0.051, 0.04, 0.05) + (1-p_T7_prior) * gpdf(0.051, -0.025, 0.05))\nprint(f\"P(tight at m7) = {p_T7:.3f}\")\n\n# Transition to m8:\np_T8_prior = 0.9 * p_T7 + 0.1 * (1 - p_T7)\n# Observe m8 spot/index = 1.375 / 2.061 = 0.667\nl_L = gpdf(0.667, 1.1, 0.33)\nl_T = gpdf(0.667, 1.8, 0.54)\np_T8 = (p_T8_prior * l_T) / (p_T8_prior * l_T + (1 - p_T8_prior) * l_L)\nprint(f\"P(tight at m8) = {p_T8:.3f}, P(loose at m8) = {1-p_T8:.3f}\")\n\n# 2. Simulate W1 (m8..15) demand with 5% noise and 50% switch to 7% in m8..15\n# Base at m7 was 7.51 (or trend 6 * 1.03^7 = 7.38)\nrandom.seed(42)\nN = 20000\nshort_no_spot = 0\ndeficits = []\nfor _ in range(N):\n    switch = random.random() < 0.5\n    sw_m = random.randint(8, 15) if switch else 99\n    cur = 6.0 * (1.03 ** 8) # trend at m8\n    tot_inf = 0\n    for m in range(8, 16):\n        if m >= sw_m and m > 8: # if switches at sw_m\n            cur = cur * (1.07 / 1.03)\n        elif m == sw_m and m == 8:\n            cur = 6.0 * (1.03 ** 7) * 1.07\n        y = cur * random.gauss(1.0, 0.05)\n        tot_inf += y\n        g = 0.07 if m >= sw_m else 0.03\n        cur = cur * (1 + g)\n    req = tot_inf + 140\n    deficits.append(req - 208.0)\n\ndeficits.sort()\nprint(f\"W1 (m8..15) deficit vs 208 kH-m (26k H):\")\nprint(f\"  Prob(deficit > 0) = {sum(1 for d in deficits if d > 0)/N:.3f}\")\nprint(f\"  Median={deficits[N//2]:+.1f}, p75={deficits[int(0.75*N)]:+.1f}, p90={deficits[int(0.90*N)]:+.1f}, p99={deficits[int(0.99*N)]:+.1f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m8_check.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m8_check.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m8_check.py","time":{"start":1794668367321,"end":1794668367325}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da920dd500155tfGHT67F08RS","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da91e2050010i4qn5CXOBbWFT"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668408949,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"ZOYu6uv4CnrW81dQ","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport math\n# obs m6..9: 7.16, 7.51, 8.49, 8.24\n# Base at m6 under 3%: 6*(1.03^6) = 7.164\nobs = [(6, 7.16), (7, 7.51), (8, 8.49), (9, 8.24)]\ndef gpdf(y, mu):\n    s = 0.05 * mu\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((y-mu)/s)**2)/s\n\n# Hypotheses (given prior 50% stay 3%, 50%/8 per switch month 8..15):\n# Stay 3%:\np_stay3 = 0.5\nfor m, y in obs:\n    p_stay3 *= gpdf(y, 6.0 * (1.03**m))\n\n# Switch at sw_m in 8..15:\np_sw = {}\nfor sw in range(8, 16):\n    p = 0.5 / 8.0\n    for m, y in obs:\n        if m < sw:\n            mu = 6.0 * (1.03**m)\n        else:\n            # switched at sw\n            mu = 6.0 * (1.03**(sw-1)) * (1.07**(m - {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668482708,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"T4oBSxHlOFisqK3x","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/plan_w2.py","content":"import math\n\n# Check inference posterior at m13 (obs m12=8.64)\nobs = [(6, 7.16), (7, 7.51), (8, 8.49), (9, 8.24), (10, 8.18), (11, 7.62), (12, 8.64)]\ndef gpdf(y, mu, frac=0.05):\n    s = frac * mu\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((y-mu)/s)**2)/s\n\np_stay3 = 0.5\nfor m, y in obs:\n    p_stay3 *= gpdf(y, 6.0 * (1.03**m))\n\np_sw = {}\nfor sw in range(8, 16):\n    p = 0.5 / 8.0\n    for m, y in obs:\n        mu = 6.0 * (1.03**m) if m < sw else 6.0 * (1.03**(sw-1)) * (1.07**(m - sw + 1))\n        p *= gpdf(y, mu)\n    p_sw[sw] = p\n\ntot = p_stay3 + sum(p_sw.values())\nprint(f\"P(stay 3%) = {p_stay3/tot:.3f}\")\nprint(f\"P(switched m8..12) = {sum(p_sw[k] for k in range(8,13))/tot:.3f}\")\nprint(f\"P(will switch m13..15) = {sum(p_sw[k] for k in range(13,16))/tot:.3f}\")\n\n# Supply at m13: prior m12 loose 0.836 -> transition 0.9*0.836 + 0.1*0.164 = 0.769 loose\npL = 0.769 * 0.25 * gpdf(0.867, 1.1, 0.3)\npT = 0.231 * 0.75 * gpdf(0.867, 1.8, 0.3)\nprint(f\"P(loose at m13) = {pL/(pL+pT):.3f}\")\n\n# Now compare W2 (m16..23) marginal cost per kH-m of different sources:\n# 1. Existing 26k H in m16..19: already powered! Marginal cost = depreciation ~ $0.15M/kH-m!\n# 2. Keeping 1k H in m20..23 by contracting 1.4 MW new power (signed by m12..15):\n#    Costs $5.04M power + $0.58M dep = $5.62M for 4 kH-m = $1.405M/kH-m!\n#    Wait: what if instead we DON'T renew power for 8.86k H in m20..23, and instead sell 3k/mo at m20..22?\n#    Wait: if we DON'T renew power, we save $5.04M/kH, get $7.51M resale vs $6.93M mark, saving $5.62M = $1.405M/kH-m,\n#    AND we replace that 4 kH-m in m20..23 with either:\n#    - Gen N bought at m14 (used m17..23 = 7m): $1.518M/kH-m (if power contracted)\n#    - 6m Cloud at m15 (m16..21) or m17 (m18..23): ~$1.45-$1.55M/kH-m (if loose!)\n#    Wait! Notice that $1.405M/kH-m (keeping H in m20..23!) is ACTUALLY CHEAPER than BOTH Gen N at m14 ($1.518M) AND 6m Cloud (~$1.50M)!!\n#    Wait: check if that's true!\n#    Wait: if we keep ALL 26k H powered in m20..23 AND ALSO buy 10k Gen N (20 kH) at m14:\n#    Total owned capacity in m17..23 = 26 + 20 = 46 kH!\n#    Power needed = 36.4 (for H) + 16.0 (for N) = 52.4 MW!\n#    We ALREADY have 40 MW in m20..23 (and 56 MW in m16..19)!\n#    So we only need +12.4 MW (say 14 MW or 16 MW) new power!\n#    Wait: what if we buy 12k Gen N (24 kH = 19.2 MW) at m14?\n#    In m17..19: 36.4 + 19.2 = 55.6 MW -> FITS UNDER 56 MW!!\n#    In m20..23: 36.4 + 19.2 = 55.6 MW -> needs +15.6 MW above 40 MW (say 16 MW signed at m13/14, energises by m16..21 -> wait, if signed at m13, 13+8=21! Could miss m20!).\n#    HOLD ON! Look at that timing:\n#    If we sign 16 MW at m13, 13 + 8 = month 21! So it could miss month 20 if energisation takes 8 months!\n#    Whereas if we sign 16 MW RIGHT NOW at month 13, it energises between m16..21 (guaranteed active by m21, 7/8 chance active by m20!).\n#    Actually: what if we sign 16 MW RIGHT NOW at month 13, vs waiting to m14?\n#    Wait: if we buy 10k-12k Gen N at m14, do we need 56 MW in m20..23?\n#    Let's check! In W2 (m16..23):\n#    - 26k H gives 26 * 8 = 208 kH-m.\n#    - 12k Gen N (24 kH) gives 24 * 7 (m17..23) = 168 kH-m.\n#    - Total = 376 kH-m (still short 30 kH-m of 406 kH-m at 3% steady, or 64 kH-m if 7% switch!).\n#    - Wait: what if we buy 14k Gen N (28 kH = 22.4 MW)?\n#      26k H (36.4 MW) + 14k N (22.4 MW) = 58.8 MW!\n#      208 + 28 * 7 = 404 kH-m! (Almost the ENTIRE 406 kH-m of W2!).\n#      And if we sign 20 MW right now at m13 (total 76 MW m16..19, 60 MW m20..23), we have FULL 60 MW for ALL 26k H + 14k N in m20..23 too!\nprint(\"\\nW2 capacity check with 26k H + 12k N + cloud/spot:\")\nprint(\"  26k H (m16..23): 208 kH-m\")\nprint(\"  12k N (24 kH, m17..23): 168 kH-m -> sum = 376 kH-m (need 406..440)\")\nprint(\"  Remaining 30..64 kH-m from m15/m17 6m cloud (e.g., 5..10 kH * 6m) + spot!\")\nprint(\"  Total MW needed in m20..23 for 26k H + 12k N = 36.4 + 19.2 = 55.6 MW -> +16 MW needed above 40 MW!\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/plan_w2.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/plan_w2.py","time":{"start":1794668482702,"end":1794668482705}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da93d08a001Mhm0GS6mkFPOqH","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da934146001QnJ5gK4QxsptnH"}}

Gen N gives 1.25 kH per MW, Gen H gives 0.714 kH per MW!\n# So in m20..23 with 56 MW, replacing 2.29k H (3.2 MW, 2.29 kH) with 2k N (3.2 MW, 4.00 kH) GAINS +1.71 kH of powered compute!!\n# AND we could even resell those 2.29k idle H at m20 for $7.51M/k!\n# Let's check exact economics of 12k N at m14 right now:\n\nprint(\"12k Gen N at m14:\")\nprint(\"  Cost: $480.0M (cash left: $78.2M)\")\nprint(\"  If loose (4k/mo): ships 4k m14, 4k m15, 4k m16 -> 12k (24 kH) usable m17..23 (7m) = 168 kH-m\")\nprint(\"  Power: 26k H (36.4MW) + 12k N (19.2MW) = 55.6 MW <= 56 MW (m20..23) and <= 72 MW (m17..19)!\")\nprint(\"  Net capex dep per kH: $20 - 0.5*0.75*40*(0.98^10) = $7.744M -> $1.106M/kH-m!\")\nprint(\"  Remaining W2 need (406 - 208 - 168 = 30 kH-m if 3%, or ~55-70 kH-m if switches 7% at m14/15):\")\nprint(\"    Can buy via 6m cloud at m15 (m16..21) & m17 (m18..23) at ~$1.35-$1.40M/kH-m, or cheap spot!\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/plan_w2_m14.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/plan_w2_m14.py","time":{"start":1794668545567,"end":1794668545569}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da94c61c001KO9y8BNvIHi19r","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da9484030012qehkf6BxvjgHM"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668597806,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"RNFltdp2zm401Mgs","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/w2_recalc.py","content":"import math\n\n# 1. Inference posterior at m16 (with m15 = 9.25)\nobs = [(6, 7.16), (7, 7.51), (8, 8.49), (9, 8.24), (10, 8.18), (11, 7.62), (12, 8.64), (13, 8.21), (14, 9.13), (15, 9.25)]\ndef gpdf(y, mu, frac=0.05):\n    s = frac * mu\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((y-mu)/s)**2)/s\n\np_stay3 = 0.5\nfor m, y in obs: p_stay3 *= gpdf(y, 6*(1.03**m))\np_sw = {}\nfor sw in range(8, 16):\n    p = 0.5/8.0\n    for m, y in obs:\n        mu = 6*(1.03**m) if m < sw else 6*(1.03**(sw-1))*(1.07**(m-sw+1))\n        p *= gpdf(y, mu)\n    p_sw[sw] = p\ntot = p_stay3 + sum(p_sw.values())\nprint(f\"Inf posterior: P(stay 3%)={p_stay3/tot:.3f}, P(switched m8..15)={sum(p_sw.values())/tot:.3f}\")\n# Most likely switch if switched: m14 or m15\nprint(f\"  P(sw m14)={p_sw[14]/tot:.3f}, P(sw m15)={p_sw[15]/tot:.3f}\")\n\n# 2. Supply at m16:\n# m15->m16 index: 1.18 -> 1.206 (+2.20% -> slightly tight? or noise on loose -2.5%!)\n# m15 cloud reserve 6 kH ACCEPTED! (tight cap is 3 kH, loose cap is 10 kH!)\n# WAIT A SECOND!!\n# `reserve 6 6` at m15 ACCEPTED ALL 6 kH!!\n# Remember: \"Providers accept at most 10 kH of new reservations per month when loose, 3 kH when tight.\"\n# So m15 was 100% LOOSE!!\n# Transition m15 loose -> m16: 0.90 loose / 0.10 tight.\n# m16 news: \"New CoWoS capacity comes online ahead of schedule.\" (loose news, 75% right)\n# m16 spot/idx: 2.176 / 1.206 = 1.804x (tight mean 1.8x vs loose 1.1x!)\npL = 0.90 * 0.75 * gpdf(1.804, 1.1, 0.3)\npT = 0.10 * 0.25 * gpdf(1.804, 1.8, 0.3)\nprint(f\"Supply m16: P(loose)={pL/(pL+pT):.3f}, P(tight)={pT/(pL+pT):.3f}\")\n\n# 3. W2 capacity budget (m16..23):\n# Expected inference in m16..23:\n# If 3% steady: sum_{m=16..23} 6*1.03^m = 85.62 kH-m (plus/minus ~2 kH-m). Need = 85.62 + 320 = 405.62 kH-m!\n# If switched at m15: sum_{m=16..23} 6*1.03^14 * 1.07^(m-14) = 113.5 kH-m -> Need = 433.5 kH-m!\ninf_3 = sum(6*(1.03**m) for m in range(16, 24))\ninf_sw15 = sum(6*(1.03**14)*(1.07**(m-14)) for m in range(16, 24))\nprint(f\"W2 need: 3% steady={inf_3+320:.1f} kH-m | sw@m15={inf_sw15+320:.1f} kH-m\")\n\n# Current committed W2 capacity:\n# 26k H (m16..23) = 208 kH-m\n# 6 kH cloud (m16..21) = 36 kH-m\n# 12k Gen N (placed m14 -> eligible m16!):\n#   If loose (4k/mo in m16,17,18): m17=8, m18=16, m19..23=24*5=120 -> 144 kH-m -> Total = 208+36+144 = 388 kH-m!\n#   If tight (1.5k/mo in m16..22): m17=3, m18=6, m19=9, m20=12, m21=15, m22=18, m23=21 -> 84 kH-m -> Total = 328 kH-m!\nprint(f\"Committed W2 (loose N): 388 kH-m (gap vs 405.6 = {405.6-388:.1f}, vs 433.5 = {433.5-388:.1f})\")\nprint(f\"Committed W2 (tight N): 328 kH-m (gap vs 405.6 = {405.6-328:.1f}, vs 433.5 = {433.5-328:.1f})\")\n\n# 4. Compare options right now at m16:\n# Option A: Reserve 6m cloud at m16 (m17..22, 6m ALL in W2!) at $1.387/kH-m!\n#   Remember: at m17, 6m cloud runs m18..23 (also 6m ALL in W2).\n#   Wait: if m16 is loose (cap 10 kH), we can reserve e.g. 4 kH (or 6 kH) at m16 ($1.387 * 6 = 24 kH-m -> brings loose W2 from 388 to 412 kH-m!).\n#   AND if m16 turns out TIGHT (only 3 kH accepted!), reserving NOW at m16 locks in 3 kH (18 kH-m) BEFORE index rises +4%/mo!\n#   AND if m16 is loose, reserving 4 kH now leaves room at m17 (for m18..23) and spot!\n# Option B: What about ordering MORE Gen N from vendor at m16?\n#   Placed m16 -> eligible m18! If #4 finishes shipping in m18, a new order at m16 wouldn't even ship until m19 (arriving m20..23)! No!\n# Option C: What about Broker B for Gen N? ($50M for 1k N = 2 kH -> arrives m18 if ordered m16 -> m18..23 = 6m).\n#   Wait: 1k N from Broker B costs $50M, mark at m24 = 0.75*40*0.98^10 = $24.51M -> net $25.49M for 12 kH-m = $2.12M/kH-m (IF 90% delivers; much worse if unreliable!).\n#   Cloud 6m right now is $1.387M/kH-m!! WAY cheaper than Broker B ($2.12M+) and even cheaper than Broker A ($1.62M+)!\nprint(\"\\n6m Cloud at m16 ($1.387M/kH-m, m17..22) is MUCH cheaper than brokers and covers m17..22!\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/w2_recalc.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/w2_recalc.py","time":{"start":1794668597802,"end":1794668597804}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da9592270016qwZjdxu3JDaf7","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da954467001sWRN6K5ns9Ynzh"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668726466,"sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"c6gukd0ON6ZtXrcX","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math, random\n\n# 1. Inference posterior at m17 (obs m16 = 8.89)\nobs = [(6, 7.16), (7, 7.51), (8, 8.49), (9, 8.24), (10, 8.18), (11, 7.62), (12, 8.64), (13, 8.21), (14, 9.13), (15, 9.25), (16, 8.89)]\ndef gpdf(y, mu):\n    s = 0.05 * mu\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((y-mu)/s)**2)/s\np_stay3 = 0.5\nfor m, y in obs: p_stay3 *= gpdf(y, 6*(1.03**m))\np_sw = {}\nfor sw in range(8, 16):\n    p = 0.5/8.0\n    for m, y in obs:\n        mu = 6*(1.03**m) if m < sw else 6*(1.03**(sw-1))*(1.07**(m-sw+1))\n        p *= gpdf(y, mu)\n    p_sw[sw] = p\ntot = p_stay3 + sum(p_sw.values())\nprint(f\"Inf posterior: P(stay 3%)={p_stay3/tot:.4f}, P(switched)={sum(p_sw.values())/tot:.4f}\")\n\n# 2. Check exact W2 m17..23 capacity vs demand\ninf_rem_3 = sum(6*(1.03**m) for m in range(17, 24))\nneed_rem = 296.89 + inf_rem_3\nprint(f\"m17..23 expected inf (3%) = {inf_rem_3:.2f}, +296.89 train = {need_rem:.2f} kH-m\")\n\n# Simulate remaining N shipments and inference noise\nrandom.seed(123)\nN_sim = 20000\nsurpluses = []\nfor _ in range(N_sim):\n    # supply starts loose at m17 (~98%)\n    tight = False\n    q = 6.9\n    n_cap = 10.2\n    cap_tot = 0\n    for m in range(17, 24):\n        cap_tot += 26.0 + n_cap + (6 if m <= 21 else 0) + (4 if m <= 22 else 0)\n        if q > 0:\n            rate = (1.5 if tight else 4.0) * random.uniform(0.7, 1.3)\n            ship = min(q, rate)\n            q -= ship\n            n_cap += ship * 2.0\n        if random.random() < 0.10:\n            tight = not tight\n    # inference m17..23 (97% 3%, 3% sw@m15)\n    if random.random() < 0.97:\n        inf_m = sum(6*(1.03**m)*random.gauss(1.0, 0.05) for m in range(17, 24))\n    else:\n        inf_m = sum(6*(1.03**14)*(1.07**(m-14))*random.gauss(1.0, 0.05) for m in range(17, 24))\n    surpluses.append(cap_tot - (296.89 + inf_m))\n\nsurpluses.sort()\nprint(f\"No extra spot/cloud in m17..23:\")\nprint(f\"  Prob(shortfall!) = {sum(1 for s in surpluses if s < 0)/N_sim:.3f}\")\nprint(f\"  p01={surpluses[int(0.01*N_sim)]:+.1f}, p05={surpluses[int(0.05*N_sim)]:+.1f}, p10={surpluses[int(0.10*N_sim)]:+.1f}, p50={surpluses[N_sim//2]:+.1f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m17_sim.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m17_sim.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m17_sim.py","time":{"start":1794668726462,"end":1794668726465}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da9788ba001WpMLMu8xMhOars","sessionID":"ses_e257fb146ffeaCf1BdMzql6rMt","messageID":"msg_1da97142b001UZfneNdaAWKNlG"}}
